title: Your Overview dashboard
description: A quick look around the home screen.

steps.title: Welcome to DoorLoop
steps.text: This is your Overview dashboard. It pulls together what needs your attention across your portfolio. Let's take a quick look around.

steps.title: Search anything
steps.text: Find any tenant, property, unit, or transaction from here. Press Cmd+K (Ctrl+K on Windows) to open it from anywhere.

steps.title: Create new
steps.text: Add a new lease, tenant, payment, task, and more without leaving the page you're on.

steps.title: Things to do
steps.text: Items that need action, like expiring leases and outstanding balances, show up here.

steps.title: Occupancy rate
steps.text: See how many of your units are occupied at a glance.

steps.title: Help & training
steps.text: Open guides and training videos whenever you get stuck.
